question: Does the target-dominant but nonselective attention value-change operation become selective when allocated separately across the four material heads?
prior_art: The aligned homogeneous factorial proves value change carries .83077/.85314 A1/A2 projection but causes five P and one C flips; pattern and interaction are low-effect and nearly control-inert. Existing factor programs allocate one subset homogeneously across all selected heads. No result independently allocates the exact value factor across L8H1, L9H1, L9H4, and L11H3 on aligned A1/A2/P/C rows.
population: The unchanged 64 capability-qualified, full-sequence-aligned rows: 16 each of A1, A2, P, and C.
factorial: Execute all 64 subsets of the six frozen bits as absolute base-plus-factor clamps in causal layer order. Complete attention 15 is clamped to donor in every arm. A base-self arm checks identity; the full six-bit arm must reproduce the valid homogeneous full-factor parent.
selection: An arm is A1-eligible when signed behavioral projection is at least .75, direction fraction at least .875, P and C each have zero top-one flips, and max separate-panel median KL is at most .02. Select fewest bits, then largest A1 projection, then numeric mask. A2 never selects.

predictions.pred_a_authority_alignment_absolute_clam: Authorities and rows match; attention reconstruction, factor closure, base self, and full-parent replay pass at <=1e-4 with matching categorical diagnostics; all metrics are finite; exactly 73 forwards execute.
predictions.pred_b_selective_head_specific_value_pro: At least one of the 64 arms is A1-eligible.
predictions.pred_c_selected_program_confirms_on_a2: Without reselection, the chosen arm reaches A2 signed behavioral projection >=.75 and direction fraction >=.875.
predictions.pred_d_value_allocation_is_proper_and_no: The selected arm uses at least one but fewer than all four head-specific value bits.
predictions.pred_e_selected_program_tracks_parent_re: The selected arm reaches final-residual signed projection >=.25 on A1 and >=.32 on A2.
predictions.pred_f_selected_program_is_necessary: Removing every selected value bit in turn either drops A1 signed projection by >=.05 or makes the arm ineligible.

terminal_policy.selective_value_behavior_only: A-D and F pass but E fails.
terminal_policy.partial: A passes and no more specific terminal applies.

next_branch: A selective program licenses source-position and QK/OV weight translation followed by fresh construction confirmation. A valid null licenses the full 12-component head-by-factor constrained greedy screen before nonlinear DAS.
